homepageTopArticles.title: Kering Eyewear and Jewelry divisions maintain positive trends in Q3 amid flat group revenue performance
homepageTopArticles.snippet: The strongest performers by division in Q3 were Kering Jewelry (+12% year-on-year on a reported basis) and Kering Eyewear (+6%) as group transformation and revitalisation of the Gucci brand continues.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Kering Jewelry grew 12% and Kering Eyewear 6% year-on-year on a reported basis in Q3, while group revenue remained flat.

homepageTopArticles.title: Hermès posts 5.5 percent Q3 sales growth driven by Europe and Americas
homepageTopArticles.snippet:
Hermès store in Abu Dhabi. Credits: Falic Group. 

French luxury group Hermès reported a 5.5 percent increase in third-quarter revenue on Thursday, supported by Europe, the Americas and Japan. The company also confirmed its full-year forecast “despite the deteriorating macroeconomic and geopolitical environment”.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Hermès reported 5.5% third-quarter revenue growth and confirmed its full-year forecast despite a deteriorating macroeconomic and geopolitical environment.

homepageTopArticles.title: Luxury retailers reportedly considering bid for De Beers
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Luxury group Richemont, owner of brands such as Cartier and Van Cleef & Arpels, is reportedly in talks to join a consortium bidding for the diamond miner De Beers Group.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Richemont is reportedly in talks to join a consortium bidding for diamond miner De Beers Group.
